title: NGINX proxy_pass URI replacement vs pass-through, exact location, no fallback
claims: proxy_pass with URI /inner/ under location /svc/ forwards /svc/x/y?q=1 as /inner/x/y?q=1
location = /exact forwards only the exact path
a server without location / does not gain a broad fallback route
not_claimed: default_server / server_name fallback for other Host values (all probes use the configured name)
the automatic 301 for /svc without a trailing slash
upstream Host header ($proxy_host vs Ferrum target authority)
source_semantics: nginx http_proxy: when proxy_pass carries a URI, the part of the normalized request URI matching the location is replaced by it; without a URI the original request URI is passed; '=' locations match exactly; with no matching location nginx serves from root and answers 404.
